    <description>Delibera — Thoughtful AI Decisions. A framework for collective decision making through structured AI deliberation. v10.3.0 is a platform release: it introduces the IDebateOrchestrator abstraction for distributed debate execution (in-process and Redis-backed), a pluggable result-caching layer (in-memory, file, Redis) with per-debate behavior control, and removes deprecated APIs (Moderator→Chairman, ModelCapabilities non-nullable, VectorStoreFactory, DebateStatus/DebateOrchestrationStatus dead values). v10.3.0 also ships a major performance & integrity pass: timer-based eviction of completed debate entries, IDisposable on internal caches, volatile int backing for cross-thread status, ConcurrentDictionary throughout, ConfigureAwait(false) library-wide, ValueTask on synchronous cache/store paths, FrozenDictionary/FrozenSet for O(1) model-registry lookups, and allocation-free single-row Levenshtein via Span<int>+stackalloc. Full feature set: multi-model councils with RAG (Qdrant, PgVector), debate strategies, Knowledge Keeper, Chairman roles, dependency injection, context compression, AutoChunking (progressive disclosure for large documents), Microsoft.Extensions.Logging, Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience (Polly v8 retry pipelines), IHttpClientFactory wiring, response-language enforcement, parallel Operator requests, async streaming council (IAsyncEnumerable<DebateRound>), pluggable voting engine (Majority/BordaCount/Weighted), debate persistence & resume via checkpoints, agent memory (in-memory/Qdrant/pgvector), OpenTelemetry-style observability (spans + metrics), structured JSON output (schema-validated verdicts with retry), adaptive strategy switching on stagnation, debate templates & presets library, multi-modal attachments via IFileContentReader, HTML export, debate timeout, persona presets, benchmark mode, and participant limit guard.</description>
    <releaseNotes>v10.3.0 — Platform Release. Distributed debates (S-01), result caching (S-03), breaking-change cleanup (P-01), Delibera.Server Minimal API, and a comprehensive performance & integrity pass.

⚠️ BREAKING CHANGES (P-01) — upgrade from v10.2.x: Moderator → Chairman (all APIs); IDebateStrategyWithOptions removed (use IDebateStrategy with DebateExecutionOptions); ModelCapabilities now non-nullable (use ModelCapabilities.IsUnknown); RagProviderFactory → VectorStoreFactory / IRagProviderFactory → IVectorStoreFactory; ILLMProvider.GetModelCapabilitiesAsync must return ModelCapabilities.Unknown(model) when unknown; DebateStatus.Paused and DebateOrchestrationStatus.Pending removed (dead enums); WeightedVotingStrategy.ResolveWeight now falls back to ballot.Weight (per-ballot weights work as documented); DebateRecord.Label defaults to string.Empty; DebateResponse now includes Label/CacheHit/CacheKey; SseDebateStreamWriter now consumes IDebateOrchestrator.StreamAsync (was DebateRecord.RoundReader); DebateOrchestrationService rewritten from 200ms polling to event-driven streaming.

S-01 Distributed Debates: IDebateOrchestrator interface (ExecuteAsync/EnqueueAsync/GetStatusAsync/StreamAsync/CancelAsync) abstracts debate execution from transport; LocalDebateOrchestrator (default in-process); RedisDebateOrchestrator (Delibera.Redis project) publishing round events to Redis Streams; DebateHandle/DebateOrchestrationStatus/DebateRoundEvent; DebateWorkerService background consumer; ICouncilBuilder.WithOrchestrator fluent API.

S-03 Result Caching: IDebateCache interface (GetAsync/SetAsync/InvalidateAsync/ExistsAsync); CacheBehavior enum (Disabled/ReadWrite/ReadOnly/WriteThrough/Bypass); DebateCacheKeyGenerator (deterministic SHA-256 key); InMemoryDebateCache/FileDebateCache/RedisDebateCache implementations; DebateResult.CacheHit/CacheKey/CachedAt; ICouncilBuilder.WithCacheBehavior and WithCache; DI extensions UseInMemoryCache/UseFileCache/UseRedisCache; debate.cache_hit OpenTelemetry counter.

Performance & Integrity: 30-min Timer-based eviction on LocalDebateOrchestrator/DebateOrchestrationService/RedisDebateOrchestrator (prevents unbounded growth); ProviderFactory disposed via using var in all server templates and ScenarioBuilder; CompressionCache and FileDebateStore now implement IDisposable; volatile int backing field for DebateRecord.Status and DebateEntry.Status (cross-thread visibility); ProviderFactory.CachingFactory uses ConcurrentDictionary+GetOrAdd; ConfigureAwait(false) added to all await in Delibera.Core and Delibera.Redis; fire-and-forget CancelAsync wrapped in Task.Run with try/catch; IDebateCache/IDebateStore/IDebateOrchestrator.GetStatusAsync return ValueTask (no Task allocation on sync paths); FrozenDictionary/FrozenSet in ModelContextWindowRegistry (O(1) lookups, cache invalidated on Register); JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes in SseDebateStreamWriter and DebateCacheKeyGenerator; single-row Levenshtein with Span<int>+stackalloc; ReaderWriterLockSlim in TokenCounter; readonly record struct RankedOption; StringBuilder capacity hints in DebateResult.ToMarkdown.

402 unit tests pass (337 Core + 65 Server). v10.2.7 — Multi-Modal Council (F-06). v10.2.6 — Nine new features: streaming, voting, persistence, agent memory, observability, structured output, adaptive strategy, templates, quick wins. v10.2.5 — OllamaProvider maxOutputTokens fix. v10.2.4 — Full CancellationToken support. v10.2.0–v10.2.3 — AutoChunking, Polly v8, parallel Operator, response language, logging, M.E.AI bridge.</releaseNotes>
